notes: Step-1 predictive pure-lateral study: altitude is fixed at 300 m and only lateral actions are allowed.
Every 5 s, the controller checks for a policy degradation inside the 60 s warning horizon.
When warned, candidates are evaluated over a common 120 s interval: 60 s warning plus 60 s extension.
The lateral candidate grid is -900 m to +900 m at 100 m spacing; the controller is not permitted to change altitude.
Candidate benefit is the reduction in integrated ordinal policy cost with l(C)=0, l(R)=1 and l(F)=2.
Among improving candidates, selection minimizes policy cost, then endpoint policy severity, displacement and maneuver duration.
Singleton exposure only: no neighboring traffic, ACC, three-dimensional conflict resolution or capacity estimate.
The 60+60 s horizons and motion limits are modular demonstration assumptions, not calibrated operational standards.
